messages:
sre-oncall-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty alert -> oncall marcos: high - per-tenant traces missing for tenant=sigma-corp in vpc-dedicated-pool-3. Bridge: https://redwood/bridges/BR-9981.
marcos: saw it, joining bridge. paging note: customer reports missing spans and partial request IDs in traces; logs still flowing to central, but traces are fragmented.
marcos: @jane can you confirm whether the trace-forwarder in that dedicated pool has had recent token refreshes? Suspect ephemeral auth to tracer proxy expired.
jane: checking. tailing forwarder logs now. quick snippet: 
```
2026-03-15T14:02:07Z forwarder[pid=22] WARN auth: tenant-token expired, dropping trace batch tenant=sigma-corp
2026-03-15T14:02:07Z forwarder[pid=22] INFO reauth: starting refresh flow
```
jane: looks like token refresh started but some batches were dropped between 14:02:00-14:04:00. forwarder restarted at 14:10 and resumed, but there is a gap.
liam_ops: customer says they see 5-10% of requests with missing spans in app traces and correlation ids not resolving in our tracing UI. They consider this high since it's an enterprise workflow.
aly_accteng: I'm on a call with Sigma-ops, they're flagging a compliance run that depends on full traces. They want ETA and whether we can replay missing spans.
marcos: assign severity P1 for customer impact on critical workflow. We'll coordinate with runtime and oncall infra. @bridge-bot, mark incident P1/sigma-corp.
bridge-bot: Incident updated: priority=P1, impacted=tenant:sigma-corp, services=trace-forwarder,dedicated-pool-3.
jane: immediate mitigation options: 1) trigger a rolling restart of forwarder instances to force token refresh; 2) enable temporary trace proxy shim that accepts replayed spans; 3) if necessary, give sigma-support a short-lived read-only link to the raw logs so they can reconstruct traces offline.
marcos: prefer (1) + (2). (3) is last resort and requires account-eng approval. jane, can you do a safe rolling restart with staggered windows? We need to keep majority of agents up.
jane: will do staggered restart across AZs: command I will run: 
```bash
for node in $(kubectl get pods -l app=trace-forwarder -o name); do
  kubectl drain $node --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data;
  kubectl rollout restart deployment/trace-forwarder -n sigma-dedicated;
  sleep 45
done
```
I'll monitor for dropped spans and auth errors.
marcos: go ahead, do one AZ first, report.
jane: AZ1 restarted. metrics: span-emitted rate back to 98% in AZ1, no auth errors in logs there. AZ2 rolling now.
liam_ops: pinging sigma-corp to confirm they see improvement. They say initial pipeline sees less drop, but still gaps for historical window 14:02-14:10. They ask if we can replay.
marcos: replay plan: if forwarder persisted spans to S3 buffer, we can replay through the proxy. jane, do we have buffer retention for this tenant?
jane: yes, the forwarder persists batches to s3://redwood-temp/sigma-corp/2026-03-15/14/ if delivery fails. Found files for 14:02-14:09. Size ~87MB.
marcos: good. Next: replay into shim that will tag and inject ids so traces correlate. Steps: create replay job, run with tenant header X-Tenant: sigma-corp, run against trace-ingest endpoint with replay-mode header. I'll prep the command.
jane: prepping job. sample replay command: 
```bash
aws s3 cp s3://redwood-temp/sigma-corp/2026-03-15/14/ batch.tar.gz
./replay-client --batch batch.tar.gz --endpoint https://ingest.redwood.internal/trace-replay --header "X-Tenant: sigma-corp" --mode append
```
jane: running dry-run first to ensure dedupe/ids.
marcos: ensure we add a metadata tag replayed=true so evaluations know these spans are backfilled. Also add a trace-flag header so UI can show them as backfilled.
liam_ops: Sigma-ops confirmed they'd accept backfilled traces marked as replayed. They want an email update once replay completes.
aly_accteng: I'm authorizing S3 read grant for sigma-support for temporary access if needed, but prefer we do the replay ourselves. I'll stand by for account-level approval in case they insist on direct access.
sigma-support: thanks team, pls confirm ETA. This gating run finishes at 16:00 UTC, we need traces before that.
marcos: target: complete replay within 40 minutes. jane, estimate duration?
jane: estimate 20-30 minutes for replay + validation. Starting actual replay now (dry-run ok).
marcos: starting incident notes for postmortem: probable root cause = ephemeral token refresh race in forwarder caused batch discard; mitigation = rolling restart & replay from s3 buffer; corrective actions = extend token expiry for dedicated-pool-3 to avoid race, add assertion + alert when forwarder emits auth:expired then drops >5% spans in 1m. Also add automated replay job if buffer files detected after auth expiry.
bridge-bot: Bridge log: user marcos added note "start replay" at 2026-03-15T14:20:00Z.
jane: replay complete. ingest reports 87MB accepted, 99.7% of missing spans reconciled. validation: sampled traces match correlation ids.
liam_ops: Sigma-ops confirms their compliance run now sees full traces for sampled requests. They will keep an eye on the next hour.
marcos: great. I'll keep this incident open for 2 hours for monitoring. Postmortem owner: jane. Action items: jane -> implement token expiry increase and alert rule; eng-runtime -> bake a safe replay automation; acct-eng (aly) -> follow up with customer comms and confirm acceptable replay metadata.
aly_accteng: sending immediate summary + joint timeline to Sigma-ops.
sre-oncall-bot: oncall marcos -> acknowledge. Incident status: monitoring.
marcos: thanks all. Closing bridge in 2h if stable.
